job.question: What is the proposal submission deadline in the Teachers' Retirement System of Oklahoma investment consultant RFP?
job.acceptance: January 14, 2026, 4pm Central Time. CT or CST acceptable for the January date.

reviews.reason: The document is a 2022 Hawaii ERS real assets investment consultant RFP, not the Teachers' Retirement System of Oklahoma investment consultant RFP. Its proposal deadline is November 30, 2022, at 4:30 p.m. Hawaii Standard Time; it provides no support for the Oklahoma RFP deadline.
quotes: Employees’ Retirement System of the State of Hawaii (ERS) Request for Proposals Real Assets Investment Consultant RFP 2022-06 Issued October 3, 2022
Closing Date for Receipt of Proposals November 30, 2022 by 4:30 p.m. (H.S.T.)
